title: Not well made
text: Not well made. It broke the first time I tried to use it. The soldering at the connection point at the bottom snapped immediately after I removed the packaging.

product_metadata.title: Love Cooking Stainless Steel Slice N Easy Cake Cutter, Red
features: Easy to hold and grip handle
Cuts a perfect slice of cake every time
description: Cut perfectly plate able cake slices with the Mrs. Fields Slice N Easy Cake Cutter - Metal. Just place the cake cutter over the cake and push down. Then squeeze the soft touch handle grips and lift up to remove the slice. Finally, place the cutter with the cake inside on a plate and release the handle and you've just served a beautiful slice.
